personality_one_liner: A highly readable, operational command center for farmers, grounded in deep earth tones with high-visibility amber alerts.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets and padding. Never cramp cards. Maintain breathable margins for outdoor readability.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and tonal differences instead of glass for maximum readability outdoors.
dont's: No blur or glass on data cards, no translucency that reduces contrast in sunlight.

screens.name: LanguageSelection
screens.purpose: First-launch screen to set the app language (English, Telugu, Hindi).
screens.layout: Centered logo at the top. 3 large, full-width selectable cards (surfaceSecondary) for each language. A sticky 'Continue' button (brandPrimary) pinned at the bottom with safe-area clearance.

screens.name: HomeDashboard
screens.purpose: Glanceable overview of GPS location, weather, soil NPK, and groundwater status.

states.error: Failed to load dashboard data, Retry button

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. 1. Hero Card: Location & Weather with the 'Indian farmer' photo as background + top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim + text overlay. 2. 2-column grid for Soil NPK and Groundwater Status cards. 3. 'Top Recommended Crop' highlighted card (spanning full width). 4. Quick Actions for 'Advisory Invoice' and 'Comparison'.

screens.name: CropRecommendations
screens.purpose: List top 5 ML-recommended crops with suitability, water demand, and voice read-out.

states.empty: No recommendations available for current soil/water.

screens.layout: List of 5 large vertical cards. Each card has: Top 40% crop photo cover with gradient scrim + Rank/Medal badge. Bottom 60% text content: Crop Name, Suitability Score (/100), Water Demand & Groundwater Risk chips (using status colors: success/warning/error), ML Confidence progress bar, 'Why this crop' text, and a prominent '🔊 Voice Read Recommendation' button in brandPrimary.

screens.name: Compare
screens.purpose: Detailed historical groundwater trends and with vs. without groundwater comparison.
screens.layout: Vertical scroll. 1. Groundwater Detail card: Status badge (Depleting=red, Stable=amber, Improving=green), mbgl metric, and a line chart (2021-2023). 2. Comparison Section: Grouped bar chart comparing yields/suitability 'With vs Without Groundwater', a list showing rank changes, and a short textual explanation card.

screens.name: AdvisoryInvoice
screens.purpose: Elegant shareable summary of the crop recommendation.
screens.layout: Full-screen modal or dedicated screen. Header says 'Crop Recommendation Advisory'. Content is styled like a clean, receipt-like list (using surfaceSecondary rows) detailing the farm parameters and top 3 crops. Sticky 'Download PDF / Share' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: App configuration including Language change, Voice toggle, and Methodology info.
screens.layout: List layout. Rows use a tinted icon container (brandTertiary rounded square) on the left, title, and trailing control (chevron or Switch). Include 'Change Language', 'Voice Read Toggle', 'Data Sources', and 'About/Methodology' which pushes to a text-heavy methodology screen.

screens.name: AboutMethodology
screens.purpose: Explain the ML models (Random Forest + XGBoost) and feature importance.
screens.layout: Text-heavy scrolling screen with typography-driven hierarchy. Include simple horizontal bar charts representing 'Feature Importance' (e.g., Soil Moisture: 35%, NPK: 25%, etc.).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility guidelines customized for this deep earthy palette. Never use generic dark mode greys; always use the provided surface hexes (e.g., #0E140D).
When placing text over the hero image or crop images, you MUST use a vertical gradient scrim (transparent -> ~20% surfaceInverse -> >=70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text contrast passes WCAG AA.
Implement charts (Line for groundwater, Grouped Bar for comparison) using react-native-chart-kit or victory-native. Ensure they are readable against the dark background.
For the 'Advisory Invoice', style it clearly as an advisory (like a receipt/report), preventing any perception that it is a bill.
Ensure 'Voice Read' buttons are large, prominent, and use the orange/amber accent (brandPrimary).
Use MaterialCommunityIcons (e.g., 'sprout', 'tractor', 'water', 'thermometer') for all domain-specific iconography.
Honor the status color requirements: green=improving, amber=stable, red=depleting.
Keep touch targets generous (minimum 44x44pt) as farmers may use the app outdoors with less precision.
Keep layout simple and modular. No glassmorphism as it degrades legibility in sunlight. Solid surfaces only.
